rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a quiet, indistinct murmuring sound.

example.english: I heard a quiet mumble coming from the next table, but I couldn't make out what they were saying.
example.traditional: 我聽到隔籬枱傳嚟一陣喃喃聲，完全聽唔清楚佢講乜。
example.jyutping: ngo5 teng1 dou3 gaak3 lei4 ci4 cyun4 lai4 jat1 zan6 naam4 naam4 sing1 jyun4 cyun4 teng1 m4 cing1 co2 keoi5 gong2 mat1

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when someone speaks indistinctly or fails to articulate clearly.

example.english: You mumble, so I can't hear what you're saying.
example.traditional: 你講嘢唔清楚，我聽唔到你講乜。
example.jyutping: nei5 gong2 je5 m4 cing1 co2 ngo5 teng1 m4 dou3 nei5 gong2 mat1

rows.note: Use this when the mumbling is mainly too quiet to hear, rather than poorly articulated.

example.english: You mumble so quietly that I can't hear you.
example.traditional: 你細聲講到咁，我點聽得到呀？
example.jyutping: nei5 sai3 seng1 gong2 dou3 gam3 ngo5 dim2 teng1 dak1 dou2 aa3

rows.jyutping: gong2 je5 ngaau5 zi6 m4 cing1
rows.note: Use this when the problem is specifically unclear pronunciation or articulation.

example.english: They mumble their words so unclearly that I still can't understand them.
example.traditional: 佢講嘢咬字唔清，我聽極都聽唔明。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gong2 je5 ngaau5 zi6 m4 cing1 ngo5 teng1 gik6 dou1 teng1 m4 ming4
